violations.text: Handwashing sink in the kitchen is lacking signage. A sign or poster must be posted to inform food employees of handwashing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
A bucket were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings in kitchen area . The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
Prep unit door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026
Hot Water is lacking at hand sinks. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. Establishment has an airbreak. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the kitchen area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2026

The walls in the kitchen area is in poor repair. Observed holes at plumbing pipes and cracked/damaged tiles. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026
The facility is lacking hot water. New Violation. Correct By: 01/27/2026
